Joshua's notes and session recaps are below.</p></div>\n+        <button type=\"button\" className=\"classroom-button\" onClick={() => choose(\"new\")}>New note</button>\n+      </div>\n+      {query.isLoading ? <p role=\"status\" className=\"student-destination-message\">Loading your notes…</p> : null}\n+      {query.isError ? <div role=\"alert\" className=\"student-destination-message\"><p>Your notes could not be loaded.</p><button type=\"button\" className=\"classroom-button\" onClick={() => void query.refetch()}>Try again</button></div> : null}\n+      {!query.isLoading && !query.isError ? (\n+        <div className=\"my-work-notes-workspace\">\n+          <div className=\"my-work-notes-list\">\n+            {notes.length === 0 ? <p>You have not written a note yet.</p> : <ul>{notes.map((note) => (\n+              <li key={note.id}><button type=\"button\" className={selectedId === note.id ? \"my-work-note-selected\" : \"\"} onClick={() => choose(note.id)} aria-current={selectedId === note.id ? \"true\" : undefined}>\n+                <strong>{note.title}</strong><span>{updatedDate(note.updated_at)}</span>\n+              </button></li>\n+            ))}</ul>}\n+          </div>\n+          {selectedId ? (\n+            <div className=\"my-work-notes-editor\" aria-label={selectedId === \"new\" ? \"New note\" : \"Edit note\"}>\n+              {selectedId !== \"new\" && !selected ? <p>This note is unavailable in your account.</p> : <>\n+                <label>Title<input type=\"text\" value={title} onChange={(event) => { setTitle(event.target.value); setSaved(false); }} placeholder=\"Untitled note\" maxLength={200} /></label>\n+                <label>Note<textarea value={body} onChange={(event) => { setBody(event.target.value); setSaved(false); }} placeholder=\"Write what you want to remember…\" rows={10} /></label>\n+                {saveError ? <p role=\"alert\" className=\"my-work-note-error\">{saveError}</p> : null}\n+                {saved ? <p role=\"status\" className=\"my-work-note-saved\">Saved to your account.</p> : null}\n+                <div className=\"my-work-notes-actions\"><button type=\"button\" className=\"classroom-button classroom-button-primary\" disabled={saving} onClick={() => void save()}>{saving ? \"Saving…\" : \"Save note\"}</button><button type=\"button\" className=\"classroom-button\" onClick={() => choose(null)}>Close</button></div>\n+              </>}\n+            </div>\n+          ) : <div className=\"my-work-notes-prompt\">Choose a note to read or write a new one.</div>}\n+        </div>\n+      ) : null}\n+    </section>\n+  );\n+}\n+\n+export default function MyWorkNotesPage() {\n+  return <div className=\"my-work-notes-page\"><StudentNotesSection /><section className=\"my-work-teacher-notes\" aria-label=\"Notes and recaps from Joshua\"><h2>From Joshua</h2><ClassroomRecapsView /></section></div>;\n+}\n*** End Patch"));

[]) as RcDrillSessionRow[]).map(toSession);\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** Save the spent clock to the existing account-owned session row. */\r\nexport async function saveSessionClock(id: string, elapsedSeconds: number): Promise<void> {\r\n  const userId = await requireUserId();\r\n  const session = await getSession(id);\r\n  if (!session || session.userId !== userId || session.status !== 'in_progress') {\r\n    throw new Error('The section is no longer available to save.');\r\n  }\r\n  await assertActivePracticeTestSession(id);\r\n  const seconds = Math.max(session.config.clockElapsedSeconds ?? 0, Math.floor(elapsedSeconds));\r\n  const { data, error } = await rcDb\r\n    .from(RC_SESSIONS_TABLE)\r\n    .update({\r\n      config: {\r\n        ...session.config,\r\n        clockElapsedSeconds: seconds,\r\n        lastActiveAt: new Date().toISOString(),\r\n      },\r\n    })\r\n    .eq('id', id)\r\n    .eq('user_id', userId)\r\n    .eq('status', 'in_progress')\r\n    .select('id')\r\n    .maybeSingle();\r\n  raise(error);\r\n  if (!data) throw new Error('The section clock did not reach your account.');\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport async function completeSession(id: string): Promise<void> {\r\n  await assertActivePracticeTestSession(id);\r\n  const { error } = await rcDb\r\n    .from(RC_SESSIONS_TABLE)\r\n    .update({ status: 'completed', completed_at: new Date().toISOString() })\r\n    .eq('id', id);\r\n  raise(error);\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport async function setSessionExcluded(id: string, excluded: boolean): Promise<void> {\r\n  const { error } = await rcDb\r\n    .from(RC_SESSIONS_TABLE)\r\n    .update({ excluded_from_analytics: excluded })\r\n    .eq('id', id);\r\n  raise(error);\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport async function deleteSession(id: string): Promise<void> {\r\n  const { error } = await rcDb.from(RC_SESSIONS_TABLE).delete().eq('id', id);\r\n  raise(error);\r\n}\r\n\r\n/* ----------------------------------------------------------------- attempts */\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * Writes one attempt row. The first write for a question within a session is the\r\n * first attempt; every later write for that same question, review re-answers\r\n * included, is a new row flagged `is_first_attempt: false`. Existing rows are\r\n * never updated, so the original answer stays intact.\r\n */\r\nexport async function recordAttempt(attempt: RcAttempt): Promise<RcAttempt> {\r\n  const userId = attempt.userId ?? (await requireUserId());\r\n  await assertActivePracticeTestSession(attempt.sessionId);\r\n\r\n  const { data: prior, error: priorError } = await rcDb\r\n    .from(RC_ATTEMPTS_TABLE)\r\n    .select('id')\r\n    .eq('session_id', attempt.sessionId)\r\n    .eq('question_id', attempt.questionId)\r\n    .limit(1);\r\n  raise(priorError);\r\n\r\n  const isFirstAttempt = (prior ?? []).length === 0;\r\n\r\n  const { data, error } = await rcDb\r\n    .from(RC_ATTEMPTS_TABLE)\r\n    .insert({\r\n      session_id: attempt.sessionId,\r\n      user_id: userId,\r\n      question_id: attempt.questionId,\r\n      passage_id: attempt.passageId,\r\n      selected: attempt.selected,\r\n      is_correct: attempt.isCorrect,\r\n      time_ms: attempt.timeMs,\r\n      flagged: attempt.flagged,\r\n      eliminations: attempt.eliminations,\r\n      is_first_attempt: isFirstAttempt,\r\n    })\r\n    .select()\r\n    .single();\r\n  raise(error);\r\n  return toAttempt(data as RcAttemptRow);\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport async function getSessionAttempts(sessionId: string): Promise<RcAttempt[]> {\r\n  const { data, error } = await rcDb\r\n    .from(RC_ATTEMPTS_TABLE)\r\n    .select()\r\n    .eq('session_id', sessionId)\r\n    .order('created_at', { ascending: true });\r\n  raise(error);\r\n  return ((data ?? []) as RcAttemptRow[]).map(toAttempt);\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** Sets the flag on every stored attempt for a question in a session. */\r\nexport async function setAttemptFlag(\r\n  sessionId: string,\r\n  questionId: number,\r\n  flagged: boolean,\r\n): Promise<void> {\r\n  await assertActivePracticeTestSession(sessionId);\r\n  const { error } = await rcDb\r\n    .from(RC_ATTEMPTS_TABLE)\r\n    .update({ flagged })\r\n    .eq('session_id', sessionId)\r\n    .eq('question_id', questionId);\r\n  raise(error);\r\n}\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * Per-question aggregate over the student's whole history, used by the hub's\r\n * status filters and by adaptive selection.\r\n */\r\nexport async function getQuestionHistory(userId?: string): Promise<RcQuestionHistory> {\r\n  const uid = userId ?? (await requireUserId());\r\n  const { data, error } = await rcDb\r\n    .from(RC_ATTEMPTS_TABLE)\r\n    .select('question_id, is_correct, created_at')\r\n    .eq('user_id', uid)\r\n    .order('created_at', { ascending: true });\r\n  raise(error);\r\n\r\n  const history: RcQuestionHistory = new Map();\r\n  for (const row of (data ?? []) as Pick<\r\n    RcAttemptRow,\r\n    'question_id' | 'is_correct' | 'created_at'\r\n  >[]) {\r\n    const existing = history.get(row.question_id) ?? {\r\n      questionId: row.question_id,\r\n      attempts: 0,\r\n      everIncorrect: false,\r\n      incorrectOnLastTake: false,\r\n      incorrectCount: 0,\r\n      lastSeenAt: null as string | null,\r\n    };\r\n    const wrong = row.is_correct === false;\r\n    existing.attempts += 1;\r\n    if (wrong) {\r\n      existing.everIncorrect = true;\r\n      existing.incorrectCount += 1;\r\n    }\r\n    // rows arrive oldest first, so the last one seen decides the latest take\r\n    existing.incorrectOnLastTake = wrong;\r\n    existing.lastSeenAt = row.created_at;\r\n    history.set(row.question_id, existing);\r\n  }\r\n  return history;\r\n}\r\n\r\n/* -------------------------------------------------------------- annotations */\r\n\r\nexport async function loadAnnotations(\r\n  passageIds: number[],\r\n): Promise<Map<number, RcHighlight[]>> {\r\n  const result = new Map<number, RcHighlight[]>();\r\n  if (passageIds.length === 0) return result;\r\n\r\n  const { data, error } = await rcDb\r\n    .from(RC_ANNOTATIONS_TABLE)\r\n    .select('passage_id, highlights')\r\n    .in('passage_id', passageIds);\r\n  raise(error);\r\n\r\n  for (const row of (data ?? []) as { passage_id: number; highlights: unknown }[]) {\r\n    result.set(row.passage_id, (row.highlights ?? []) as RcHighlight[]);\r\n  }\r\n  return result;\r\n}\r\n"}]

Every one of them keeps\r\n * working: the query is carried across verbatim.\r\n *\r\n * A link that carries any builder query also asks for the builder stage. Landing\r\n * a `start=1` link on the hub's default RC stage would drop it on the floor —\r\n * the builder that reads those params would not be mounted to read them.\r\n */\r\nexport default function RcRedirect() {\r\n  const { search, hash } = useLocation();\r\n  const params = new URLSearchParams(search);\r\n  params.delete(DRILL_SECTION_PARAM);\r\n\r\n  const carries = params.toString().length > 0;\r\n  const next = new URLSearchParams(params);\r\n  next.set(DRILL_SECTION_PARAM, 'rc');\r\n  if (carries) next.set('stage', 'type-drill');\r\n\r\n  return <Navigate to={`/classroom/drill?${next.toString()}${hash}`} replace />;\r\n}\r\n"}, {'type': 'input_text', 'text': "###1\nsrc/features/rc/pages/RcPlayer.tsx:575:      navigate(`/rc/results/${sessionId}${returnTo ? [{'type': 'input_text', 'text': 'Script completed\nWall time 0.7 seconds\nOutput:\n'}, {'type': 'input_text', 'text': "/**\r\n * Loader for the static RC bank in public/data/rc/.\r\n *\r\n * The index is small and loads once; per-PrepTest files load on demand and stay\r\n * cached in memory for the life of the page.\r\n */\r\nimport type {\r\n  RcIndex,\r\n  RcIndexPassage,\r\n  RcPassage,\r\n  RcPreptestFile,\r\n  RcQuestionIndex,\r\n} from './rcTypes';\r\n\r\nlet indexPromise: Promise<RcIndex> | null = null;\r\nlet questionIndexPromise: Promise<RcQuestionIndex> | null = null;\r\nconst preptestCache = new Map<number, Promise<RcPreptestFile>>();\r\n\r\nasync function fetchJson<T>(url: string): Promise<T> {\r\n  const res = await fetch(url);\r\n  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Failed to load ${url} (${res.status})`);\r\n  return (await res.json()) as T;\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** Loads (and caches) the passage index. Safe to call from anywhere. */\r\nexport function loadRcIndex(): Promise<RcIndex> {\r\n  if (!indexPromise) {\r\n    indexPromise = fetchJson<RcIndex>('/data/rc/rc-index.json').catch((err) => {\r\n      indexPromise = null; // let a later call retry rather than caching a failure\r\n      throw err;\r\n    });\r\n  }\r\n  return indexPromise;\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** Loads (and caches) the flat question search index used by `/rc/search`. */\r\nexport function loadRcQuestionIndex(): Promise<RcQuestionIndex> {\r\n  if (!questionIndexPromise) {\r\n    questionIndexPromise = fetchJson<RcQuestionIndex>('/data/rc/rc-question-index.json').catch(\r\n      (err) => {\r\n        questionIndexPromise = null; // let a later call retry rather than caching a failure\r\n        throw err;\r\n      },\r\n    );\r\n  }\r\n  return questionIndexPromise;\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** Loads (and caches) one PrepTest's passages and questions. */\r\nexport function loadPreptest(preptest: number): Promise<RcPreptestFile> {\r\n  const cached = preptestCache.get(preptest);\r\n  if (cached) return cached;\r\n\r\n  const promise = fetchJson<RcPreptestFile>(`/data/rc/RC-PT${preptest}.json`).catch((err) => {\r\n    preptestCache.delete(preptest);\r\n    throw err;\r\n  });\r\n  preptestCache.set(preptest, promise);\r\n  return promise;\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** Finds which PrepTest a passage belongs to, then loads that passage in full. */\r\nexport async function loadPassage(passageId: number): Promise<RcPassage | null> {\r\n  const index = await loadRcIndex();\r\n  const pt = index.preptests.find((t) => t.passages.some((p) => p.passageId === passageId));\r\n  if (!pt) return null;\r\n  const file = await loadPreptest(pt.preptest);\r\n  return file.passages.find((p) => p.passageId === passageId) ?? null;\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** Loads several passages, one PrepTest fetch per distinct test, order preserved. */\r\nexport async function loadPassages(passageIds: number[]): Promise<RcPassage[]> {\r\n  const index = await loadRcIndex();\r\n  const ptByPassage = new Map<number, number>();\r\n  for (const pt of index.preptests) {\r\n    for (const p of pt.passages) ptByPassage.set(p.passageId, pt.preptest);\r\n  }\r\n  const needed = [...new Set(passageIds.map((id) => ptByPassage.get(id)).filter(Boolean))];\r\n  const files = await Promise.all(needed.map((n) => loadPreptest(n as number)));\r\n  const byId = new Map<number, RcPassage>();\r\n  for (const f of files) for (const p of f.passages) byId.set(p.passageId, p);\r\n  return passageIds.map((id) => byId.get(id)).filter(Boolean) as RcPassage[];\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** Every passage in the index, flattened, with its PrepTest attached. */\r\nexport async function loadAllIndexPassages(): Promise<(RcIndexPassage & { preptest: number })[]> {\r\n  const index = await loadRcIndex();\r\n  return index.preptests.flatMap((pt) => pt.passages.map((p) => ({ ...p, preptest: pt.preptest })));\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport {\r\n  RC_TOPICS,\r\n  RC_FORMATS,\r\n  RC_FRAMEWORKS,\r\n  RC_QUESTION_TYPES,\r\n"}]

[{'type': 'input_text', 'text': 'Script completed\nWall time 4.9 seconds\nOutput:\n'}, {'type': 'input_text', 'text': 'import type { RcAttemptRow, RcDrillSessionRow } from "@/features/rc/api/rcSupabase.types";\r\nimport type { RcQuestionIndexEntry } from "@/features/rc/lib/rcTypes";\r\nimport type { ReviewQueueItem } from "./reviewQueueModel";\r\n\r\n/** Completed standalone drills only. A practice test section must await its run\'s review gate. */\r\nexport function buildRcReviewQueue(\r\n  attempts: RcAttemptRow[],\r\n  sessions: RcDrillSessionRow[],\r\n  questionIndex: RcQuestionIndexEntry[],\r\n): ReviewQueueItem[] {\r\n  const validSessions = new Map(sessions\r\n    .filter((session) => session.status === "completed" && !session.practice_test_run_id &&\r\n      !(session.config && typeof session.config === "object" && "practiceTestRunId" in session.config && session.config.practiceTestRunId))\r\n    .map((session) => [session.id, session]));\r\n  const questions = new Map(questionIndex.map((question) => [question.questionId, question]));\r\n  const groups = new Map<string, RcAttemptRow[]>();\r\n\r\n  for (const attempt of attempts) {\r\n    const session = validSessions.get(attempt.session_id);\r\n    const question = questions.get(attempt.question_id);\r\n    if (!session || !question || attempt.user_id !== session.user_id || question.passageId !== attempt.passage_id) continue;\r\n    const key = `${attempt.session_id}:${attempt.question_id}`;\r\n    const group = groups.get(key) ?? [];\r\n    group.push(attempt);\r\n    groups.set(key, group);\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  const items: ReviewQueueItem[] = [];\r\n  for (const [key, group] of groups) {\r\n    group.sort((a, b) => a.created_at.localeCompare(b.created_at) || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));\r\n    const first = group.find((attempt) => attempt.is_first_attempt) ?? group[0];\r\n    const last = group.at(-1)!;\r\n    const firstMiss = group.find((attempt) => attempt.selected && attempt.is_correct === false);\r\n    const flagged = last.flagged === true;\r\n    if (!firstMiss && !flagged) continue;\r\n    const question = questions.get(first.question_id)!;\r\n    const reasons: ReviewQueueItem["reasons"] = [];\r\n    if (firstMiss) reasons.push("missed");\r\n    if (flagged) reasons.push("flagged");\r\n    items.push({\r\n      key: `rc:${key}`,\r\n      area: "rc",\r\n      qid: String(question.questionId),\r\n      label: `PT${question.preptest}–S${question.section}–Q${question.position}`,\r\n      qtype: question.questionType || null,\r\n      reasons,\r\n      sources: ["rc_attempts"],\r\n      firstAnswer: first.selected,\r\n      latestAnswer: [...group].reverse().find((attempt) => attempt.selected)?.selected ?? null,\r\n      correctAnswer: null,\r\n      firstMissAt: firstMiss?.created_at ?? null,\r\n      lastActivityAt: last.created_at,\r\n      reflection: null,\r\n      flaggedNote: null,\r\n      href: `/rc/drill?sessionId=${encodeURIComponent(first.session_id)}&review=1&q=${question.questionId}`,\r\n    });\r\n  }\r\n  return items.sort((a, b) => b.lastActivityAt.localeCompare(a.lastActivityAt));\r\n}\r\nimport { rcDb, RC_ATTEMPTS_TABLE, RC_SESSIONS_TABLE, type RcAttemptRow, type RcDrillSessionRow } from "@/features/rc/api/rcSupabase.types";\r\nimport { loadRcQuestionIndex } from "@/features/rc/lib/rcBank";\r\nimport { buildRcReviewQueue } from "./rcReviewAdapter";\r\n\r\nconst PAGE_SIZE = 500;\r\n\r\nasync function ownedRows<T>(table: string, userId: string, dateColumn: string): Promise<T[]> {\r\n  const rows: T[] = [];\r\n  for (let start = 0; ; start += PAGE_SIZE) {\r\n    const { data, error } = await rcDb.from(table)\r\n      .select("*")\r\n      .eq("user_id", userId)\r\n      .order(dateColumn, { ascending: true })\r\n      .order("id", { ascending: true })\r\n      .range(start, start + PAGE_SIZE - 1);\r\n    if (error) throw error;\r\n    const page = (data ?? []) as T[];\r\n    rows.push(...page);\r\n    if (page.length < PAGE_SIZE) return rows;\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport async function loadRcReviewQueue(userId: string) {\r\n  const [sessions, attempts, index] = await Promise.all([\r\n    ownedRows<RcDrillSessionRow>(RC_SESSIONS_TABLE, userId, "started_at"),\r\n    ownedRows<RcAttemptRow>(RC_ATTEMPTS_TABLE, userId, "created_at"),\r\n    loadRcQuestionIndex(),\r\n  ]);\r\n  return buildRcReviewQueue(attempts, sessions, index.questions);\r\n}\r\n\r\n    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json",\r\n\r\n'}]

[]) as RcAttemptRow[]).map(toAttempt);\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** Sets the flag on every stored attempt for a question in a session. */\r\nexport async function setAttemptFlag(\r\n  sessionId: string,\r\n  questionId: number,\r\n  flagged: boolean,\r\n): Promise<void> {\r\n  await assertActivePracticeTestSession(sessionId);\r\n  const { error } = await rcDb\r\n    .from(RC_ATTEMPTS_TABLE)\r\n    .update({ flagged })\r\n    .eq('session_id', sessionId)\r\n    .eq('question_id', questionId);\r\n  raise(error);\r\n}\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * Per-question aggregate over the student's whole history, used by the hub's\r\n * status filters and by adaptive selection.\r\n */\r\n/**\r\n * Row types for the three RC progress tables.\r\n *\r\n * These live here, not in src/integrations/supabase/types.ts, because that file\r\n * is generated and must not be hand-edited. Until it is regenerated, the RC\r\n * tables are unknown to the typed client, so `rcDb` casts it once, in one place,\r\n * rather than scattering `as any` through the API layer.\r\n */\r\nimport { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';\r\nimport type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';\r\n\r\nexport interface RcDrillSessionRow {\r\n  id: string;\r\n  user_id: string;\r\n  config: unknown;\r\n  passage_ids: number[];\r\n  status: string;\r\n  excluded_from_analytics: boolean;\r\n  started_at: string;\r\n  completed_at: string | null;\r\n  practice_test_run_id?: string | null;\r\n  practice_test_leg?: number | null;\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport interface RcAttemptRow {\r\n  id: string;\r\n  session_id: string;\r\n  user_id: string;\r\n  question_id: number;\r\n  passage_id: number;\r\n  selected: string | null;\r\n  is_correct: boolean | null;\r\n  time_ms: number;\r\n  flagged: boolean;\r\n  eliminations: string[];\r\n  is_first_attempt: boolean;\r\n  created_at: string;\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport interface RcAnnotationRow {\r\n  user_id: string;\r\n  passage_id: number;\r\n  highlights: unknown;\r\n  updated_at: string;\r\n}\r\n\r\n/** The Supabase client, untyped, for the RC tables only. */\r\nexport const rcDb = supabase as unknown as SupabaseClient;\r\n\r\nexport const RC_SESSIONS_TABLE = 'rc_drill_sessions';\r\nexport const RC_ATTEMPTS_TABLE = 'rc_attempts';\r\nexport const RC_ANNOTATIONS_TABLE = 'rc_annotations';\r\n"}]
